name: Tangleweave Armor
blocked_sentences: Equipped creature gets +X/+X, where X is the greatest mana value among your commanders.

needs.what: a static value (usable as a buff's power/toughness) giving the greatest mana value among the cards that are your commanders, read wherever those commanders are (command zone, battlefield, hand, graveyard, exile, library), and 0 if you have none
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_value_keys has const, count, counters_on, mana_symbols, max_count_of, min_count_of and life readers, but nothing reads a mana value; max_count_of is the largest per-player COUNT of matching objects (used for 'an opponent controls more lands'), not the largest mana value among objects. The value_keys mana_value_of/extreme_value are effect-time values not accepted by a static, and the cost_reduction greatest_mana_value key exists only for cost reduction, not buff magnitudes. A selector with is_commander would also only see one zone, while a commander is usually in the command zone
